description: dryvist/.github nix preset. Nix repos extend `local>dryvist/.github:renovate-nix`. It enables Renovate's native `nix` manager: flake input bumps join the repository's grouped Saturday PR, and lockFileMaintenance relocks the whole flake (channel-pinned inputs included) in the same Saturday window.

The `.nix` version-pin customManager (fetchPypi/fetchurl pins carrying a `# renovate:` annotation) is a SEPARATE mechanism defined in the default preset — it edits version strings inside .nix files, never flake.lock.
